Degree Programs
Find your program
At NMSU, you'll discover some of the nation's most innovative programs in business, healthcare, engineering, and more. With more than 80 majors to choose from — taught by skilled, student-focused professors — you can expand your horizons through internships and global research opportunities here and around the world. Discover your passion and explore career options in just a few clicks.
